host: MacBook Pro, Apple M3 Pro, 18 GiB unified memory, macOS 14.7.8

protocol.model: Same installed Qwen3.5-0.8B 4-bit MLX weights and full-vocabulary target. CPU llama.cpp drafts under high pressure, MTP/Metal otherwise.
protocol.render: Independent 1280x720 60-Hz Metal renderer, 1450 shader iterations. Service-time P95 describes the simulator. On-device GPU utilization is sampled at 0.5 s where available. No game client or loudspeaker was running.
protocol.timing: All reported speedups are 1 - candidate median / reference median. P95 is nearest rank. Each worker is warmed on a separate clip and the run order is interleaved. Fixed requests start from the original six-frame JPEG and end at the complete returned text including IPC. The native replay starts from native capture timestamps, feeds 5-Hz video into the 2-Hz game scheduler, and records the production observation and speech publication callbacks.
protocol.quality: Report all trials, the intersection that has a complete JSON object with a legal scene plus nonempty observation and valid cited frame IDs, and product-parser acceptance separately. Accept at most one outer Markdown fence for measuring complete content from the initial worker. No frame IDs, text, or output budget are supplied to the model as answers.
protocol.long_prompt: 六张连续截图按左上到右下从早到晚排列。请复盘可见变化，只输出 JSON 对象。在 scene 写 fighting、settled 或 unclear；在 observation 用两三句完整中文描述角色或镜头的变化、场景与界面里的可见证据；在 observed_frames 数组写出依据的帧号。看不清的内容请如实说明，不猜测剧情、名称或数值。
protocol.raw: profile_output/validation.tar.gz (local). Headline paired results and original outputs are also included below.
